Ahvothian.name: Ahvothian
Ahvothian.publicNotes: Ahvothians are feral and cunning fiends from an Abyssal realm of jungles, dinosaurs, and relentless brutality. They resemble humanoid dinosaurs with narrow, fanged heads similar to raptors and solid, heavy legs like sauropods. Relentless trackers and survivalists, ahvothians are skilled at navigating jungles and are most commonly encountered stalking prey or operating out of fortified ruins. Ahvothians have an uncanny affinity with reptiles, and they often use dinosaurs-particularly carnivores such as allosauruses or deinonychuses-as hunting companions or guard animals. Although dangerous in large groups, ahvothians have such a strong desire to assert dominance over others that ahvothian armies frequently fall to infighting and bloody battles for dominance within days, or even hours. The mightiest ahvothians might lead dozens of their kin and herds of carnivorous dinosaurs.

These exceptions are listed in shortened form in the golem's stat block, with the full rules appearing here. If an entry lists multiple types (such as "cold and water"), either type of conjuro can affect the golem.

  • Harmed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to take the listed amount of daño (this daño has no type) instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of magic of this type or is affected by a persistent effect of the appropriate type, it takes the daño listed in the parenthetical.
  • Healed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem makes the golem lose the ralentizado condition and gain HP equal to half the daño the conjuro would have dealt. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it gains the HP listed in the parenthetical.
  • Slowed By Any magic of this type that targets the golem causes it to be @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.xYTAsEpcJE1Ccni3]{Lentificado 1} for [[/br 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds} instead of the usual effect. If the golem starts its turn in an area of this type of magic, it's ralentizado 1 for that round.
  • Vulnerable To Each golem is vulnerable to one or more specific conjuros, with the effects described in its stat block.

Fuming Sludge.name: Fuming Sludge
Fuming Sludge.publicNotes:
The slurry from alchemical experiments is often as flammable as it is toxic. In especially volatile cases, a fuming sludge can form from ignited pools of unstable alchemical runoff. It resembles a charcoal-colored slurry studded with tiny embers, and it continually emits a thin haze of accelerant that amplifies the fires it starts.

A fuming sludge must consume the base chemicals of living creatures to survive and can instinctively identify the complex molecules found in most animate creatures. The first meal of many a fuming sludge is its accidental creator, but it soon moves on to hunt in lush forests or densely populated settlements. A fuming sludge can extrude a powerful pseudopod to strike its victims, but it can also eject portions of its body with peristaltic contractions. These rapidly-cooling globs of goo slow down fleeing prey, but the cold, crusty residue can also alert canny explorers to their presence.

action->Chemical Sense 60 feet.name: Chemical Sense 60 pies
action->Chemical Sense 60 feet.description: A fuming sludge detects nearby living and undead creatures by their complex chemical compositions, but it can't detect elementals or other creatures composed of a single element.

action->Smoldering Haze.description:

The smoke doesn't impair the fuming sludge's chemical sense. A creature that enters the aura or begins its turn in the aura becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Indispuesto 1} (@Check[fortitude|dc:25] negates) and cannot recover from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.lDVqvLKA6eF3Df60]{Persistente Fire Damage} for 1 round. It is then temporarily immune to the sickening effect of the smoldering haze for 1 minute.

A creature that is currently holding its breath, that doesn't need to breathe, or that's immune to poison is immune to the aura's sickened effect but not the concealment or inability to recover from daño persistente de fuego.

action->Keen Eyes.name: Keen Eyes
action->Keen Eyes.description:
Paga gains a +2 bonificador de circunstancia when using the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.BlAOM2X92SI6HMtJ]{Seek} action to find @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Escondido} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{No detectado} creatures within 30 pies of her.

When she targets an opponent that is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Oculto} from her or hidden, she reduces the DC of the prueba plana to 3 for a concealed target or 9 for a hidden one.

action->Halfling Luck.name: Halfling Luck
action->Halfling Luck.description:
Desencadenante Paga fails or critically fails a prueba de habilidad or a tirada de salvación

Frecuencia una vez al día

Efecto Paga rerolls the tirada de salvación and must take the new result.

action->Feign Harmlessness.name: Feign Harmlessness
action->Feign Harmlessness.description:
Paga cringes and cowers before a creature within 10 pies that can see her. The target must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save.

The target is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Éxito crítico No effect.

Éxito The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AdPVz7rbaVSRxHFg]{Fascinado} by Paga until the end of its next turn.

Fallo The creature is fascinated by Paga and can't use hostile actions against her until the end of its next turn.

Fallo crítico As failure, and the creature isn't temporarily immune to Feign Harmlessness.

action->Unbreakable Concentration.name: Unbreakable Concentration
action->Unbreakable Concentration.description: Paga's conjuros are disrupted by reactions only if she is critically hit.

Scroll Shock Trap.name: Scroll Shock Trap
Scroll Shock Trap.description: Five scroll symbols shoot electricity bolts around the room.
Scroll Shock Trap.disable:
@Check[thievery|dc:25|name:Counteract Magic|rasgos:action:disable-a-device] (expert) or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conjuros-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (3rd rank; counteract DC 24)

@Check[thievery|dc:29|name:Disable Trap (Control Panel)|rasgos:action:disable-a-device] (master) to disable the entire trap from the hidden control panel beneath the central slab.
Scroll Shock Trap.reset: The trap deactivates 1 round after it has no target creatures and resets after 1 minute.
Scroll Shock Trap.routine:
(5 actions) Each disabled symbol reduces the trap's number of actions by 1.

For each of its actions, a different symbol shoots an electricity bolt at a random creature in the room. The trap doesn't take multiple attack penalties.
Scroll Shock Trap.stealth: (expert) or @Check[perception|dc:29|rasgos:action:seek] (expert) to spot the control panel

action->Reactive Charge.name: Reactive Charge
action->Reactive Charge.description:
Desencadenante A creature without an Aspis Consortium badge approaches within 5 pies of a slab

Efecto Both double doors leading out of the room shut and lock. While the trap is active, the doors must be battered open (Hardness 18; Panel HP 72 [BT 36]; @Check[athletics|dc:29|name:Batter Down Doors|rasgos:action:force-open] to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.SjmKHgI7a5Z9JzBx]{FORCE OPEN}). The closest symbol to the triggering creature shoots an electricity bolt attack at it. The trap then rolls initiative.

Stalker Summoning Rune.name: Stalker Summoning Rune
Stalker Summoning Rune.description: The sand conceals a rune that summons an invisible stalker into this yard.
Stalker Summoning Rune.disable: @Check[acrobatics|dc:25|name:Approach Rune] to approach without triggering the trap followed by @Check[arcana|dc:25|name:Erase Rune] (expert) or @Check[thievery|dc:27|name:Erase Rune|rasgos:action:disable-a-device] (expert) to erase the rune, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conjuros-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic} (4th rank; counteract DC 25) to counteract the rune

action->Summon Monster.name: Summon Monster
action->Summon Monster.description:
Desencadenante A creature that isn't openly bearing an Aspis Consortium badge crosses the center of the yard

Efecto The trap summons an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.pathfinder-monster-core.Actor.HKXa9E91WLy6dAZA]{Invisible Stalker}. The invisible stalker rolls initiative and remains for [[/gmr 2d6 #rounds]]{2d6 rounds}, after which the conjuro ends and the invisible stalker disappears. The invisible stalker also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The invisible stalker can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.
